jobs.description: Silver refresh of the 월별 전기 lane `building-energy-monthly-electricity` (root ADR-0169 ②, ADR-0396): every Bronze object is a release of one usage month; load the first object, oldest ledger month first, whose parts silver.building_energy_monthly_electricity does not record yet (`unchanged` when every one is), stage it on a load branch, compare only that usage month's bucket with the table's current rows and append to main the rows of the 지번 whose month changed and a removal marker per 지번 that month no longer holds (compare.bucket_scope release; root ADR-0318), and read it back (`changed`). One release per run is the cap: a month is 1.46M rows, a hub part lane's monthly size. Started when a source_sweep run lands new files, and daily as the fallback (root ADR-0171). One lane runs at a time: each takes the compose `spark` cap.

expected_outcome.basis: building HUB files are released monthly (expected_cadence monthly, 1080 h, in the endpoint catalog) plus one daily fallback; measured 2026-11-11 from each unit's journal, 10-12..11-11 (read-only): changed 6 times, longest gap 20.6 h.

assets.title: 건물 전기 사용량(월별)
assets.description: 지번마다 사용 월의 전기 사용량 행 묶음: 사용년월·지번·사용량. 공장이 돌고 있는지(가동·공실)의 신호다. 판 하나가 사용 월 하나이고, 다시 실린 달은 그 달만 비교한다. 원문 17칸 보존. 읽는 소비자(필지 by-PNU 패널)는 다음 PR 이라 그때까지 섬으로 둔다(루트 ADR-0396).

dependencies.description: 월별 전기 사용량(eais_elcty_{YYYYMM}.txt) 17칸을 사용 월마다, 그 달의 바뀐 지번만 append-only Silver 로 쌓는다(루트 ADR-0396).
dependencies.pnu_resolution: pnu composed at Silver by the Rust hub/VWorld export (export-*-silver-handoff, standard_pnu_from_hub_register_codes / ADR-0145), not a raw provider code; the consumer carries a retired legal-dong code to the current pnu through the place-identity resolver and follows views.changed_codes (ADR-0288, ADR-0329, ADR-0396)
